players.product: Regulated electric service under the Very Large Customer (VLC) tariff, with new gas, renewable and battery generation and transmission built for Microsoft's data center campus in the I-94 corridor south of Milwaukee and the Vantage Data Centers / Oracle site at Port Washington, Wisconsin

quarterly_data.signal: WEC 10-K: no customer accounted for more than 10% of revenues in 2025. Wisconsin Electric has contracts with a small number of customers to provide power to large-scale data centers to support AI, is incurring significant costs to construct bespoke resources to serve them, and requires these customers to enter into payment and cancellation agreements. WEC forecasts 2026 retail electric sales volumes (excluding the Tilden mine) to increase 1.6% versus 2025 assuming normal weather, and relatively flat excluding the very large data center customers. 2025 electric utility operating revenues were $5,529.6 million versus $4,908.4 million.
quarterly_data.figure: no customer above 10% of revenues; 2026 retail electric sales forecast +1.6%
